requirements.name: HEVY_UPDATE_DELETE_REVISION
requirements.assertion: Hevy update/delete yields revisions/corrections, not destructive overwrite.

requirements.name: HEVY_UNKNOWN_EXERCISE_NO_BLUEPRINT_CREDIT
requirements.assertion: Unknown Hevy exercise preserves actuals but cannot auto-resolve blueprint role.

requirements.name: HEALTHKIT_NO_VISIBLE_DATA_NOT_ZERO
requirements.assertion: No visible HealthKit samples maps to unknown/partial coverage, never zero or denied certainty.

requirements.name: HEALTHKIT_DELETION_PROPAGATES_CORRECTION
requirements.assertion: Anchored deleted objects produce source correction/invalidation.

requirements.name: WEARABLE_STRENGTH_DOES_NOT_INVENT_SETS
requirements.assertion: HealthKit/Oura workout labels cannot create strength set/reps/load facts.

requirements.name: CROSS_SOURCE_WORKOUT_COUNTS_ONCE
requirements.assertion: Hevy+HealthKit+chat for one workout remains one underlying event.

requirements.name: OURA_AI_DENIED_BEFORE_GATE
requirements.assertion: Oura evidence cannot enter production AI context before compliance policy enablement.

requirements.name: OURA_ABSENCE_DEGRADES_NOT_BLOCKS
requirements.assertion: Oura unavailable yields reduced completeness but does not block planner when other required evidence satisfies policy.

requirements.name: NO_HEVY_MANUAL_FALLBACK
requirements.assertion: Without Hevy, manual strength actual ingestion works and wearable labels do not fill missing sets.

requirements.name: NO_HEALTHKIT_PARTIAL_PLANNING
requirements.assertion: Without HealthKit, partial-data planning works only when policy permits and missing recovery values remain unknown.

requirements.name: PROVIDER_OUTAGE_DOES_NOT_BLOCK_STOP
requirements.assertion: Provider outages/retry saturation cannot starve STOP/protective control path.
